title: ModsPack project configuration
description: modspack.config.json at the project root. Every key is optional; the defaults are listed in each description.

mode.description: enforce (default): failed gates exit non-zero. advisory: report only, always exit 0 unless a check could not run and is required.

adapters.description: AI tools to install integrations for. Default: the ones detected in the project, else all four.

skills.description: Skills to install. Default: every shipped skill.

agents.description: Agents to install. Default: every shipped agent.

agentNames.description: Display names for agents, by technical ID, for example {"release-manager": "Atlas"}. Only the display name changes; the ID, instructions, tools and files do not. Names are unique, start with a letter, and use letters, digits, spaces and hyphens (at most 32 characters).

exclude.description: Globs no scan reads (added to the built-in node_modules, .git, dist, build, coverage).

guards.description: Turns each deterministic check on or off for modspack check and release-check.

failOn.description: Lowest severity of a confirmed finding that fails the gate. Default: high.

enabled.description: Scan git history for secrets. Default: true.

dependencyAudit.description: Run the package manager's audit (sends the dependency list to the registry). Default: false.

externalScanners.description: Run gitleaks or osv-scanner when installed locally. Default: true. Nothing is downloaded.

accepted.description: Findings dismissed or accepted on purpose. Each needs a reason; accepted risks also need approvedBy.

hipaa.description: auto (default): deeper HIPAA-related review when health-data signals are found. on: always. off: never.

publicContacts.description: Email addresses and phone numbers that are meant to be public (support@, the press line).

allowDomains.description: Email domains never flagged. example.com, example.org, example.net and test are always allowed.

required.description: Checks that must have a script. A required check with no script is BLOCKED, never passed. Default: [].

scripts.description: Script names per check, first match wins (as qa-gate's scripts option).

required.description: When true, a project with UI files but no axe-core/jsdom is BLOCKED rather than SKIPPED. Default: false.

paths.description: Globs of files to check. Default: every .html, .css, .tsx, .jsx, .vue file.

requiredGates.description: Gates that must PASS for release-check to say READY. Default: quality, security, privacy, accessibility, package.

dir.description: Where --write puts reports. Default: .modspack/reports. Add it to .gitignore.
